title: dryopteris elwesii
intro: Dryopteris elwesii, commonly known as Elwes' male fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, pain, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris elwesii include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve symptoms such as coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
